feed.headline: Pope Leo ends France trip in Metz, spotlighting Schuman and EU unity
feed.ai: Pope Leo XIV ended his four-day visit to France in Metz on Monday by urging Europe to build on its Christian heritage and culture of dialogue rather than succumb to what he called the “desire for domination” behind many of today’s wars.
